description: This file defines an interface `AddressReadPlatformService` which provides methods for retrieving address-related data within the Fineract project. It specifies various retrieval methods based on client ID, address type, status, search parameters, and includes a method for retrieving a template address.

classes.name: AddressReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that defines the contract for address retrieval operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveAddressFields
methods.description: Retrieves address fields for a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientAddress
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyType
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a client filtered by address type ID.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses filtered by address type ID and status for a specific client.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a client filtered by address status.

methods.name: retrieveBySearchParam
methods.description: Retrieves addresses based on complex search parameters provided via ClientAddressSearchParam.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template AddressData object, possibly for UI forms or default values.
